description: The end plug's parent (layout_2) turns 90 about X while the start's stays. The end follows its plug's frame (design/ribbon-twist-follow.md): the end's total twist is 0 from its control plus extractTwist of its plug's motion relative to the start's, which is 90. The twist ramps linearly along the whole ribbon, so the joints at u = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1 turn 0, 22.5, 45, 67.5 and 90, and the interior marker (u = 0.5) 45. Nothing moves: the curve is the same line.
